svg.title: Build tone with gaps and layers
svg.desc: Four original ballpoint-like patches contain actual strokes of equal width: spaced single hatching, closer single hatching, two crossing families, and denser crossing. The open paper gaps decrease rather than the pen stroke becoming heavier. Below, cross-contour strokes curve and change direction around a curled paper ribbon; a light section is left open. Coverage controls tone while direction describes a surface. The strokes are schematic, not calibrated ink or a required crossing angle.

g.text: Build tone with gaps and layers
